audit_scope: Read existing completed report and current source; no models, servers, microphones or paste actions were run by this audit.

backend_and_device.scope: device=npu is assigned by fastflowlm_backend.transcribe after a successful owned-server HTTP result. This report contains no per-job accelerator file-descriptor/kernel trace; earlier separate SDK evidence demonstrates actual device use for that stack.

worker_and_queue.worker_pid_measurement: Captured at each successful result, not continuous process census; no FLM child PID reported. The recorded PID is absent at audit time.
worker_and_queue.submission_pattern: Sequential: submit one file, wait for delivered result, schedule next with QTimer.singleShot(0, submit). One outstanding request by construction.

cleanup.measurement: finish calls jobs.cancel(), TemporaryDirectory.cleanup(), then records not Path(temporary.name).exists(). Script removes each copied job WAV after successful delivery.
cleanup.scope: Positive final cleanup observation from runner; no per-job cleanup timing/history or independent directory path remains in report. Not evidence that recorder-created audio cleanup was tested.

latency.elapsed_semantics: worker.py lines127-130: time from immediately after JSON request parsing through run(), including VAD, model checks, backend setup/inference, postprocessing and performance recording. Excludes initial Python process startup/imports, Qt dispatch/response handling, WAV copying, microphone capture and paste.
latency.processing_semantics: fastflowlm_backend.py lines86-104: includes start(settings), possible server startup, input read, multipart creation and HTTP inference/JSON response. Excludes outer VAD, model verification and postprocessing; not pure NPU kernel time.
latency.cold_start_caveat: First job includes lazy work inside those timers, but is not a full app cold-start or stop-speaking-to-paste measurement. Warm pooled medians combine four different input durations; compare per-source statistics for repeat stability.

not_proven: Microphone capture, disconnection, silence or loss-free recording
Global shortcut and target-window focus behavior
Clipboard preservation or exactly-once target-app paste
Multiple queued jobs, queue overflow or concurrent submission
Cancellation during active inference, forced worker crash or recovery
Per-job physical accelerator utilization, power or memory-leak trend
100 distinct audio inputs: this run uses four fixtures repeated25times
30 percent end-to-end improvement against a paired baseline
Cross-distribution or cross-hardware behavior; stress report does not capture OS/Flatpak identity, settings snapshot or runtime binary/model revision hash
verdict: PASS for 100 sequential successful delivered ASR jobs with unique IDs, one observed worker PID, stable repeated outputs and runner-reported final temporary-directory cleanup. Broader application and release gates remain unproven.
